documentation.description: Network: the sockets the library reads and writes, which other tasks and the system change.

simple_types.name: Outcome
simple_types.code:
type Outcome is
  (Done,
   Want_Read,
   Want_Write,
   Closed,
   Failed);

enumeration_literals.name: Want_Read
enumeration_literals.description: wait until the socket is readable, then call again

enumeration_literals.name: Want_Write
enumeration_literals.description: wait until the socket is writable, then call again

enumeration_literals.name: Failed
enumeration_literals.description: see Last_Failure; the session is of no more use

enumeration_literals.name: Full
enumeration_literals.description: a chain to a trusted root, and the certificate names the host asked for

enumeration_literals.name: Chain_Only
enumeration_literals.description: a chain to a trusted root, whatever host it names

enumeration_literals.name: Nothing
enumeration_literals.description: encryption without authentication: anyone can sit in the middle
